data_sources.name: LEHD LODES 8, Workplace Area Characteristics 2016 and geography crosswalk, Maryland
data_sources.how: Download md_wac_S000_JT00_2016.csv.gz and https://lehd.ces.census.gov/data/lodes/LODES8/md/md_xwalk.csv.gz (other states: .../LODES8/<st>/wac/<st>_wac_S000_JT00_<year>.csv.gz). steps.what: input_check, part 1: keep a copy of the provided estimation and hold-out tables
steps.command: rm -rf provided_estimation provided_holdout && cp -R estimation provided_estimation && cp -R holdout provided_holdout

steps.what: Build the estimation and hold-out tables from the inputs (same calls and random draws as the original run; asserts that the LL of the former and of the final model at their estimates is reproduced)
input_check, part 2: compare the rebuilt tables with the provided ones (rows, column sums, largest difference); must print ALL TABLES MATCH
Log-likelihood at the reference coefficients (no estimation, nothing written)
Biogeme estimation, start values = reference estimates
Compare the estimates with the reference (reference_estimates.csv)

notes: Sampled alternatives: the exact 100-zone sets of the original estimation (seed 20261106), in the data; no correction term.
Size term mu ln(total jobs): the job-type log weights g are fixed at 0 (Beta status 1).
Person variables of the car-time interactions are centred at their estimation-half means (columns *_c; constants in centring_constants.csv), including the household without a car (car0_c).
Robust s.e.: sandwich over the 24 estimated parameters; the original estimator counted the fixed job-type weights too (larger s.e. for the zone job-mix terms); the reference holds the corrected s.e.
The hold-out half was also used in the specification search; its log-likelihood is not a fully independent test.
Delete ../output/__workplace_choice.iter before estimating a changed specification (Biogeme starts from the values saved there).
Steps with output_provided = true can be skipped: their results are in input/data or 00_shared_data. Upstream project stages were not re-run for this package; their runtimes are not measured.
Measured here: --check 15 s; estimation about 45-75 s, 7.6 GB.
Environment: Biogeme scripts and package build scripts run with ~/.venvs/biogeme/bin/python (Biogeme 3.3.5); project scripts with /opt/homebrew/anaconda3/bin/python3 (needs geopandas).
